_note: Les voix a accent leger des cinq soignants (decision de Jacques du 14 nov. 2026, pflege/VOIX.md). Concues par Voice Design (audio/concevoir_voix.py) ; texte d'essai = une vraie replique du personnage. Rien n'est concu sans l'autorisation de Jacques.

elif.description: A Turkish woman in her late twenties, a hospital nurse from Izmir, speaking fluent, correct German with a light but clearly audible Turkish accent: slightly rolled r, open vowels, even syllable rhythm. Warm, calm and professional, natural pace, close microphone, clean studio sound. Not a native German speaker, not a heavy or caricatured accent, not breathy, not girlish, not overly cheerful.
elif.essai: Guten Morgen, Herr Brandt. Mein Name ist Elif, ich bin heute Ihre Pflegekraft. Wie haben Sie heute Nacht geschlafen?

yusuf.description: A Syrian man in his early thirties, a night-shift nurse from Damascus, speaking fluent, correct German with a light but clearly audible Arabic accent: rolled r, firm h sounds, slightly flattened ü and ö. Calm, focused and worried, reporting to a doctor on the phone. Mid pitch, clearly a young adult. Clean studio sound. Not a native German speaker, not a heavy or caricatured accent, not a deep bass voice, not theatrical.
yusuf.essai: Ich mache mir Sorgen. Sein Zustand hat sich in der letzten Stunde deutlich verschlechtert. Ich habe Angst, dass es etwas mit der Lunge ist.

amira.description: A Tunisian woman in her late twenties, a home-care nurse, speaking fluent, correct German with a light but clearly audible North African Arabic accent, a hint of French in the vowels, rolled r. Friendly, patient and reassuring with an elderly lady. Natural pace, clean studio sound. Not a native German speaker, not a heavy or caricatured accent, not breathy, not girlish.
amira.essai: Ein hoher Blutdruck ist schlecht für das Herz. Die Tablette senkt den Blutdruck und schützt so auch das Herz.

arun.description: An Indian man from Kerala in his early thirties, a night-shift nurse in a care home, speaking fluent, correct German with a light but clearly audible South Indian accent: retroflex t and d, syllable-timed rhythm, clear tapped r. Soft, gentle and very calm, speaking to a confused elderly man at night. Clean studio sound. Not a native German speaker, not a heavy or caricatured accent, not a British or American accent.
arun.essai: Das klingt schön. Wissen Sie, jetzt ist noch mitten in der Nacht. Die erste Bahn fährt erst morgen früh.

olena.description: A Ukrainian woman in her mid-forties, a care assistant in a nursing home, speaking fluent, correct German with a light but clearly audible Ukrainian accent: soft consonants, rolled r, slightly closed vowels. Warm, motherly and patient while helping an old man eat. Natural pace, clean studio sound. Not a native German speaker, not a heavy or caricatured accent, not breathy.
olena.essai: Heute gibt es Kartoffelsuppe und danach Hähnchen mit Püree. Setzen Sie sich bitte gerade hin, dann geht das Essen leichter.
